formulations.Polymer system Notes: Amorphous PEO copolymer with randomly-spaced oxy-methylene units inserted into linear PEO chain (n~9, m~600).
formulations.Notes: Sample kindly provided by C.V. Nicholas (University of Manchester).
formulations.Reference: [5] C.V. Nicholas, D.J. Wilson, C. Booth and J.R.M. Giles, in: Intern. Symp. on Polymer Electrolytes, St. Andrews, June 1987.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: Amorphous PEO copolymer with randomly-spaced oxy-methylene units inserted into linear PEO chain; formula: -[(CH2-CH2-O)n-CH2-O]-m where n varies randomly around 9 and m is about 600.
formulations.Reference: E. Linden and J.R. Owen, Solid State Ionics 28-30 (1988) 994-1000.
